description: Revisits Cosmos’s astronomy through discoveries since 1980, from Voyager and exoplanets to precision cosmology, Mars exploration, and climate, distinguishing predictions from revisions.

Pulsar planet discoveries reported in 1992 and first exoplanet around an ordinary star 51 Pegasi b in 1995.
Modern approximate age 13.8 billion years and observational cosmology.
Acceleration of cosmic expansion, open mechanism behind dark energy.
Dense CO2 atmosphere, greenhouse effect and modern Venus conditions.
NASA reports no credible evidence of extraterrestrial life or alien UAPs as of reference date.
Venus-Earth climate differences and history relevant to greenhouse analogy.
Original episodes, broad subjects, broadcast chronology; not a substitute for inspecting film sequences.
